Health and Independence Report 2023 Supplementary Data Tables

Published: July 2024

Introduction

These supplementary data tables present a range of unpublished health data used to inform the 2023 Health and Independence Report. Additional published data sources used by the 2023 Health and Independence Report are referenced in the report.

This human-readable format can be used to explore the data. Alongside this document, the data is available as a machine-readable CSV file.

Section one: New Zealand Health Survey

Most Health Survey data in the Health and Independence Report 2023 is presented as a three-year rolling average. This means that each statistic is averaged across three consecutive years of survey data from three Health Survey cycles. For example, data representing the three-year pooled period ending 2022/23 contains data from the survey years 2020/21, 2021/22 and 2022/23 (data collected from mid-2020 to mid-2023). The three-year pooled data presented in this report differs from the annual data published in the Annual Data Explorer.

Annual data from the New Zealand Health Survey can be accessed through the Annual Data Explorer.

Readers should refer to the accompanying CSV file for lower and upper confidence intervals surrounding the data.
